clips.title: The story
paras: In Shadowglen, a coded summons calls new night elf rogues to begin their training. Conservator Ilthalaine carries it for Frahun Shadewhisper, who also warns of the fragile peace across Kalimdor.

While young night elves study nature's balance under Conservator Ilthalaine, those drawn to stealth receive a quieter summons. A runner brings the Encrypted Sigil from Frahun Shadewhisper, Shadowglen's rogue mentor. Its ciphers are meant for initiates of the trade. The bearer is to decipher the message and find Frahun near the roots of Aldrassil to begin instruction.

Frahun's message also warns of Kalimdor's uncertain peace. The Third War has ended, but the truce between the Alliance and the emerging Horde remains fragile. Rogue scouts and informers in Shadowglen are urged to sharpen their eyes and ears early. They watch for threats and covert provocations that could renew war across the borders.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our rogue trainer, Frahun. It seems Frahun would have words with you when you have a moment. Read it and bring it to him afterwards.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, friend. I'm glad you found me. I was thinking that perhaps you got lost on the way here.
Nothing really new has happened in Shadowglen since I sent you my sigil, but I'll leave all the information gathering to you. Speak to the rest of the people around Aldrassil if you'd like.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Until then, know that our kind are needed more than ever in this tenuous time. Peace with the other races can fail at any moment, and there is much talk about members of the Horde looking to sow even greater seeds of distrust. Remember that.
As you gain in power and feel more prepared, come back to me here and I will see about getting you some training. It's important that you know how to handle your weapon of choice, among other things.
